# Stockfish 18 (lite, single-threaded WebAssembly build)

`stockfish-18-lite-single.js` and `stockfish-18-lite-single.wasm` are unmodified
copies of the files with the same names in the npm package
[stockfish@18.0.8](https://www.npmjs.com/package/stockfish/v/18.0.8):
Stockfish.js by Nathan Rugg and Chess.com, based on Stockfish by the Stockfish
developers.

## Source code

- Stockfish.js 18.0.8, the exact source and build scripts for these two files:
  https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/tree/v18.0.8
- Stockfish 18, the upstream engine:
  https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish/tree/sf_18
